description: Recovered summary of EA Sports FC / FIFA-style player overall rating research delegated to subagents by World Cup 2026 group.
importantCaveat: This is not an official FIFA governing-body rating dataset. It summarizes public EA Sports FC-style overall ratings collected by subagents. The raw subagent transcripts were not written to the repository; this file preserves the recovered thread summary so future chats can access the work.
sourcePriority: Official EA Sports FC ratings pages when exact player matches were available
Reputable EA FC rating mirrors such as FC Ratings, FIFA Index, FIFACM, SOFIFA, FUTWIZ, CMTracker, and FCRadar
Null for players where no reliable exact current rating was found

recommendedUse.apply: Normalize into CSV columns player_name,overall before running npm run data:ratings.
recommendedUse.confidencePolicy: Use high and reviewed medium confidence ratings. Leave null or low-confidence values unmatched so the existing deterministic team-median fallback applies.

caveats: EA public FC26 pages state ratings reflect Gold/Silver/Bronze Ultimate Team 26 launch items and exclude later live-form updates, campaign items, Heroes, and Icons: https://www.ea.com/games/ea-sports-fc/ratings
The raw EA ratings API currently returned FC25-like values for some players, so visible official FC26 player pages were used over raw API values.
FIFA Index/FCRadar fallback pages may include career-mode/snapshot updates rather than EA launch Ultimate Team item ratings; fallback confidence is medium.

caveats.note: Latest checked public official source: EA SPORTS FC 26 ratings reveal. EA states the table reflects launch Ultimate Team Gold/Silver/Bronze items, not campaign items or live-form updates.
Reputable mirrors were checked only for unresolved names; customized/user-created or concept-style entries were treated as unreliable and returned null.
Medium confidence means exact public FC 26 player match but the EA nationality/name form differs from the requested national-team context or common-name form.

FIFACM/FIFA Ratings/CMTracker values were used only where FC Ratings had no match and search results exposed an explicit FC 26 overall; confidence is lower for non-official or conflicting mirror-only results.

caveats: Official EA Sports FC 26 ratings were preferred for exact player/nationality matches. FIFA Index and FC Ratings were used only where official EA did not expose an exact current match or where the mirror provided a later FC 26 update record.
Some mirror databases include national-team/free-agent entries that are not visible in EA's public ratings reveal page; those are marked medium or low confidence.
rating:null means no reliable current EA/EA FC-style overall rating was found during this pass, not that the player has no real-world evaluation.
Latest checked as public EA SPORTS FC 26 ratings on EA pages where available; EA official values override mirrors.
Mirror values use current FC 26-style pages only when official EA was absent; confidence is lower.
Null means no reliable current public FC 26/FIFA-style overall found without relying on stale historical entries.
